title: Gene network analysis combined with preclinical studies to identify and elucidate the mechanism of action of novel irreversible Keap1 inhibitor for Parkinson's disease.
authors: Arumugam, Monisha; Pachamuthu, Ranjith Sanjeeve; Rymbai, Emdormi; Jha, Aditya Prakash; Rajagopal, Kalirajan; Kothandan, Ram; Muthu, Santhoshkumar; Selvaraj, Divakar
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦Keap1蛋白共价抑制剂发现与帕金森病神经保护机制，核心为蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The cysteine residues of Keap1 such as C151, C273, and C288 are critical for its repressor activity on Nrf2. However, to date, no molecules have been identified to covalently modify all three cysteine residues for Nrf2 activation. Hence, in this study, our goal is to discover new Keap1 covalent inhibitors that can undergo a Michael addition with all three cysteine residues. The Keap1's intervening region was modeled using Modeller v10.4. Covalent docking and binding free energy were calculated using CovDock. Molecular dynamics (MD) was performed using Desmond. Various in-vitro assays were carried out to confirm the neuroprotective effects of the hit molecule in 6-OHDA-treated SH-SY5Y cells. Further, the best hit was evaluated in vivo for its ability to improve rotenone-induced postural instability and cognitive impairment in male rats. Finally, network pharmacology was used to summarize the complete molecular mechanism of the hit molecule. Chalcone and plumbagin were found to form the necessary covalent bonds with all three cysteine residues. However, MD analysis indicated that the binding of plumbagin is more stable than chalcone. Plumbagin displayed neuroprotective effects in 6-OHDA-treated SH-SY5Y cells at concentrations 0.01 and 0.1 muM. Plumbagin at 0.1 microM had positive effects on reactive oxygen species formation and glutathione levels. Plumbagin also improved postural instability and cognitive impairment in rotenone-treated male rats. Our network analysis indicated that plumbagin could also improve dopamine signaling. Additionally, plumbagin could exhibit anti-oxidant and anti-inflammatory activity through the activation of Nrf2. Cumulatively, our study suggests that plumbagin is a novel Keap1 covalent inhibitor for Nrf2-mediated neuroprotection in PD.
abstract_zh: Keap1的半胱氨酸残基，如C151、C273和C288，对其抑制Nrf2的活性至关重要。然而，迄今为止，尚未发现能共价修饰所有三个半胱氨酸残基以激活Nrf2的分子。因此，在本研究中，我们的目标是发现新的Keap1共价抑制剂，这些抑制剂能够与所有三个半胱氨酸残基发生Michael加成反应。使用Modeller v10.4对Keap1的中间区域进行建模。共价对接和结合自由能使用CovDock计算。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 使用Desmond进行。进行了多种体外实验，以确认命中分子在6-OHDA处理的SH-SY5Y细胞中的神经保护作用。此外，评估了最佳命中分子在体内改善雄性大鼠中鱼藤酮诱导的姿势不稳定和认知障碍的能力。最后，使用网络药理学总结命中分子的完整分子机制。发现查尔酮和plumbagin能与所有三个半胱氨酸残基形成必要的共价键。然而，MD分析表明，plumbagin的结合比查尔酮更稳定。Plumbagin在0.01和0.1 μM浓度下，对6-OHDA处理的SH-SY5Y细胞显示出神经保护作用。Plumbagin在0.1 μM浓度下，对活性氧形成和谷胱甘肽水平有积极影响。Plumbagin还改善了鱼藤酮处理的雄性大鼠的姿势不稳定和认知障碍。我们的网络分析表明，plumbagin还能改善多巴胺信号传导。此外，plumbagin可能通过激活Nrf2表现出抗氧化和抗炎活性。综合来看，我们的研究表明，plumbagin是一种新型的Keap1共价抑制剂，用于PD中Nrf2介导的神经保护。
